fixed.summary: Answers are written by types generated from the IDL, so they carry what the IDL declares: a binding in og.input.actions (bindings, defaults) and og.input.capture now has every declared field (control, negative, positive, up, down, left, right, scale, invertY, deadzone, zone, radius); a field at its default used to be left out.

Numbers the IDL declares f32 are written as f32, as the API types them: choices[].check.target and chance, lastCheck.target, displayHz, frameMs, parse's at and soundInfo's seconds can differ in the last digits (0.1 reads as 0.10000000149011612).
